title: Localized Hom germ comparison for a complex on the base
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point, $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(S_{et}))$, $L$ a K-injective cochain complex of abelian etale sheaves on $S$, $r:K\cong QL$, $n\in\mathbf Z$, and $i$ a representative affine pointed neighbourhood. Use the free sheaf and canonical source germ leg of [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs]. Define $E_i$ from $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathbf Z[V_i][0],K[n])$ to $H^n(L(V_i))$ by the bounded-below inclusion, transport by $r$, the K-injective localization bijection, Hom-complex homology, and degreewise free-generator evaluation, exactly as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison], stopping before any stage pullback. Define $b_i:H^n(L(V_i))\to\Gamma(S_{(s)},H^n(g^{-1}K))$ by applying the neighbourhood section restriction of [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-restriction] degreewise to $L$, taking homology, using the exact-inverse-image localization comparison, transporting by $g^{-1}r^{-1}$, and commuting exact strict-local sections with homology. These constructions do not choose a representative of a class. Then the canonical source germ leg equals $E_i b_i$. No morphism $f$, base-change mate or fibre cohomology is involved.

source.place: Tags 03Q8 and 03Q9; cohomology of a K-injective complex and the canonical neighbourhood restriction

proof.text: Move the canonical derived-sections comparison across the presheaf germ by toPresheafFiber_naturality. Use the characterizing equation of the chosen unique stalk restriction to express the source leg as the germ-comparison component, the neighbourhood section restriction, and the exact-inverse-image homology comparison. This is the proved private helper sourceLeg_eq_sectionRestriction.

Use surjectivity of the inverse composite of sourcePlusHomIso and sourceClassDerivedHomIso to represent an arbitrary derived Hom element by a CohomologyClass. Use mk_surjective and Cocycle.fromSingleMk_surjective to represent it by an actual single-source cycle f. Cancellation of the Hom isomorphisms proves heval, expressing sourceLocalizedSectionsIso on this element as the evaluated Hom-complex homology class.

Apply sourceLocalizedCocycleHomology to identify the germ-comparison component with the homology section of f. Apply sourceCocycleExactRestriction with the proved natural transformation strictLocalSectionRestrictionNat. Its two sides are precisely the section-restriction side and strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction of the evaluated Hom-complex class. Symmetry gives the required equality for every derived Hom element, and extensionality gives the morphism equality.

lean.statement: theorem sourceLocalizedSectionsIso_germ {S : Scheme.{v}} {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})) (L : CochainComplex (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ) [L.IsKInjective] (r : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) (n : ℤ) (i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)) : (strictLocalCohomologySourceLegs s K n).app (op i) = (sourceLocalizedSectionsIso K L r n ((strictLocalNeighbourhoods s).obj i)).hom ≫ strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction s K L r n i
